versions.content: To select the DTC , the Dcm module shall call the API Dem_SelectDTC() with the following parameter values: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef ) • DTC: DTC from the service request • DTCFormat: DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS • DTCOrigin: DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY
